description: Powered dispensers spawn the mobs of spawn eggs (SpawnEggItemBehavior: DISPENSER spawn in front, moved down unless facing up) and of mob buckets (the filled bucket behaviour: water or nothing, then MobBucketItem.spawn with the bucket's components and bucket_entity_data), leaving empty buckets (#183). Gold blocks mark each mob with its item's data; the sulfur cube is outside the observed region (its swallowed-block archetypes are not simulated yet).

actions.command: execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:pig,nbt={variant:"minecraft:cold"}] run setblock 0 -55 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:chicken] run setblock 1 -55 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:cod,nbt={FromBucket:1b}] run setblock 2 -55 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:axolotl,nbt={Variant:4,FromBucket:1b}] run setblock 3 -55 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:tadpole,nbt={FromBucket:1b}] run setblock 4 -55 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:sulfur_cube,nbt={from_bucket:1b,AgeLocked:1b,equipment:{body:{id:"minecraft:dirt"}}}] run setblock 5 -55 0 minecraft:gold_block
execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:tropical_fish,nbt={FromBucket:1b}] run setblock 6 -55 0 minecraft:gold_block
